slot_note: Batch 3 re-root of the Data Quality Monitoring slot: the school-leaver survey world (architectures 1 and 2) is closed; architecture 3 moves to official price statistics, a national statistics office assessing its field price-collection contractor from back-checks made on a regional circuit days after collection
niche: a national statistics office's quarterly assessment of the contractor that collects its consumer price index prices in the field: for each collection region and outlet stratum (multiple and independent outlets), whether the third-quarter 2026 price recording is compliant, needs accompanied collection (corrective action) or also earns a service credit under the Price Collection Quality Standard, judged on the share of recorded prices that were the outlet's price when the collector recorded them, estimated from the Field Quality Team's back-checks, which re-collect sampled outlets on a fixed regional circuit from the day of collection to about a week after it
answer_source: submission.md block 1; golden pcqs_2026q3_assessment.xlsx sheet Assessment
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the standard and every file correctly takes each region and stratum's accuracy as the share of its back-checked prices that agree with the Field Quality Team's re-collection, applies the standard's bands and puts corrective action or a service credit on most of the regions the circuit reaches days after collection, though their collectors recorded the prices on offer; excluding disagreements on sale prices or keeping only the back-checks made within two days still files those regions wrong.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each region and stratum's price-collection accuracy at the moment of recording, estimated from re-collections made later by netting each back-check's chance of a genuine price change over its own delay, read from each item's monthly frequency of price change in the price database (the price statistician's measure of price stickiness); replaced by the raw agreement, a sale-excluded agreement or a same-week subset the outcomes change, so the price-statistics method, not the setting, decides.
layer1: the contractor's visit log stamps visits in UTC from the handhelds while the back-check forms carry local dates, with the daylight-saving change inside the quarter
the price database records quotes by reference month and status code, and the handheld software update in August 2026 replaced the letter status codes with numeric ones
outlets keyed by the contractor's outlet number in the visit log and by the NSO's outlet code in the price database, crosswalked through the outlet register
back-check forms keyed from paper with the officer's initials, local dates in day-month order and an occasional form keyed twice
stakeholder_role: head of the Prices Division at the national statistics office, who signs the quarterly Price Collection Quality Standard assessment that sets the field contractor's corrective actions and service credits

spine.entity: one field-collected price quote (an item variety at an outlet) in one reference month

world.geography: a fictional English-speaking country of about 5.1 million (its national statistics office, field contractor, collection regions, outlets and people are fictional; personas on the New Zealand index)
world.org_type: national statistics office (prices division) and its contracted field price-collection firm

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of readings that were right at the moment they were taken, checked by re-reading a sample some days later; a later re-reading also disagrees wherever the thing read changed in between, so the error share is the disagreement net of each check's own chance of a genuine change over its delay, read from each item's rate of change in the main record, while counting every disagreement as an error charges the units checked longest after to their readers.
driver_concrete: The Field Quality Team re-collects prices at sampled outlets on a fixed regional circuit, the capital regions within a day of collection and the far regions about a week later, and any price that changed in between disagrees with the collector's; netting each back-check's chance of a genuine change over its own delay, from the item's monthly frequency of price change in the price database, clears the far regions' collectors and puts corrective action where recording errors are real.
stump: A competent solver takes each region and stratum's accuracy as the share of back-checked prices that agree with the Field Quality Team's re-collection and puts corrective action or service credits on most of the far regions' cells; the step that lands it there is counting every disagreement as a collector's error when the re-collection came days later and a share of prices, set by each item's frequency of price change and each back-check's delay, had genuinely changed in between.

differentiation.task270: task270 v9 reads a variance of change between two self-ratings at a fixed interval from ratings taken at other intervals (a curve of mean square move against the time between readings); this build reads no variance and no interval curve: each back-check's disagreement is split into the collector's error at the moment of recording and a genuine price change over that back-check's own delay, the change chance read from each item's monthly frequency of price change in a second file, so the estimand is an error share at delay zero, not a dispersion at a chosen lag.

lineage.architecture: v2 (architecture 2, shipped 2026-10-16, follow-up in five districts across the island's range)
lineage.fate: re-rooted 2026-11-01 at the Batch 3 queue reset (shipped 2026-10-16, no portal result; the school-leaver survey world is closed)
lineage.driver: A departure between the group missing a value and the values imputed for it is measured on a gold-standard follow-up across the full range of base rates and has to be carried to every unit; carried as a fixed difference in points, pooled or per stratum, or as a ratio of rates, it misfits the follow-up because base rates vary inside each stratum as well as between strata, while one odds ratio fits every unit and stratum, so each unit's shift follows its own base rate and its share missing.
lineage.driver_concrete: The 2025 nonresponse follow-up, in five districts chosen across the island's range, found nonrespondents NEET far more often and in higher education far less often than the destination model allocated them: a pooled gap of about 15 and 11 points that grows with the allocation, by band and by district within a band, while one odds ratio, about 2.5 and 0.40, fits every district and band; carried as points it overstates the NEET shift in the affluent districts, understates it in the deprived and misses both higher-education suppressions; carried nonrespondent by nonrespondent on the logit scale it gives each statistic's shift and flag.
lineage.stump: A competent solver adds the follow-up's pooled points gap to each district's nonrespondents and files 11 of the 24 flags wrong: caution for the NEET rates of Southern Shore, Upper Valley and Glen Villages (standard), suppression for Hill Country's and Northern Plains' (caution), caution for City West's and City East's (suppression), caution for the Hill Country and Northern Plains higher-education entry rates (suppression) and for Old Docks' and Mill Towns' (standard); the step that lands it there is carrying a departure measured across allocations from under 1 to over 55 per cent as a fixed number of points instead of nonrespondent by nonrespondent on the odds scale, the one scale on which the follow-up's districts and bands agree.
lineage.answer: Suppress the NEET rates of City East, City West and Riverside and the higher-education entry rates of Hill Country and Northern Plains; publish the NEET rates of Southern Shore, Glen Villages and Upper Valley and the higher-education entry rates of Old Docks and Mill Towns with the standard flag; publish the other 14 statistics under caution.

lineage.architecture: v1 (architecture 1, built 2026-10-16, follow-up in the five middle and deprived districts)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-16 at stage 4: judge SEND_BACK (underspecified_objective). The follow-up covered only Market Towns, Coastal Strip, Riverside, City West and City East, so inside each attainment band its allocations barely varied and a points gap or a ratio per band fitted it within 1 to 4 log-likelihood units of the odds scale while giving other flags; the prompt's 'rate the release will publish' was also open for suppressed statistics
lineage.driver: A departure between the group missing a value and the values imputed for it is measured on a gold-standard follow-up only where base rates sit in one range and has to be carried to every unit; carried as a fixed difference in points it overstates the shift where the base rate is low and understates it where it is high, and a ratio of rates drifts too, while on the odds scale, the one on which the followed-up units and bands agree, it transports, so each unit's shift follows its own base rate and its share missing.
lineage.driver_concrete: The 2025 nonresponse follow-up found nonrespondents NEET far more often and in higher education far less often than the destination model allocated them, a pooled gap of about 17 and 11 points that grows with the model's own allocation while the odds ratio holds near 2.6 and 0.45 across the five followed-up districts and the four attainment bands; carried as points it overstates the NEET shift in the affluent districts, understates it in the most deprived and overstates the HE shift where HE entry is low; carried leaver by leaver on the logit scale it gives each district's NEET and HE shift and so its flag.
lineage.stump: A competent solver adds the follow-up's pooled points gap to each district's nonrespondents and suppresses the low NEET rates of Southern Shore, Hill Country, Northern Plains and Market Towns, cautions Upper Valley's and Glen Villages's NEET rates, leaves Mill Towns' NEET rate under caution and cautions the Old Docks and Mill Towns HE rates; the step that lands it there is carrying a departure measured where allocations are middling as a fixed number of points instead of leaver by leaver on the odds scale, on which the followed-up districts and attainment bands agree.
lineage.answer: Suppress the NEET rates of City East, City West, Riverside and Mill Towns; publish the NEET rates of Southern Shore, Glen Villages and Upper Valley and the higher-education entry rates of Old Docks and Mill Towns with the standard flag; publish the other 15 statistics under caution.
